text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, right in the middle of our time at summer camp, I bump into Mejiro Ardan standing around having a chat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're Ardan's trainer! Like, how's it going?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's Mejiro Palmer. She's a cheerful Umamusume with explosive breakaway speed. She's also a member of the Mejiro family, and I hear she talks with Mejiro Ardan all the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! You know that thing we were talking about just now? You should totally ask your trainer about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I should!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Since we're all going to be off tomorrow, we were talking about getting the Mejiros together for a day by the sea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ardan was saying she hasn't really gotten to play at the beach much before, so we were all gonna hit the public beach together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, the camp supervisors said that a chaperone would be necessary if were planning a group excursion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If you happen to be free as well, Trainer, would you mind accompanying us? As a guardian of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Well then, I shall see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so here I am at the beachfront with Ardan and the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Simply seeing the shack stirs so many emotions. My heart's pounding already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's, like, such an Ardan thing to say. Okay, first, how about we sit down and eat?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that. Where's everyone going to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a stunning lineup of shaved ice. You can really sense the passion of the staff who arranged it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: For sure. Strawberry milk, matcha, mango, ramune… They've got the basics covered and they've got some out-there options to boot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What flavor are you getting, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With this many options, I can't make my mind up… Which will you be going with, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm going with this one! Chocolate protein shaved ice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I might have known you'd choose that flavor, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Have a look at this "Sweet Memory" juice, Dober. Isn't it adorable how the straw's shaped like a heart?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I do find it strange that this straw has two heads, though. How do you suppose one's supposed to drink from it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's just say that it's, um… it's not really for us, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Whyever not? If you know, I'd love if you'd enlighten me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! Um, well… it's designed that way so two people who are… uh, close… can drink from it together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That sounds perfect for us, then! We are close, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant! Ughhh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Some things never change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's wonderful to see everyone enjoying themselves. Shall we follow suit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must say, though… the sheer variety of food available at the snack shack is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Meh, there are fancier tiki bars out there with, like, a more mature vibe, but this one's definitely giving the classic beach feel, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now that we're looking at the menu, my eyes can't help but dart from one dish to another. It feels as though I'm exploring uncharted territory…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about this? "Flaming Spice vs. Extreme Tongue Tingles"! OMG, that sounds so fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And it's only available this summer? …It sounds like a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Wonderful. I think I shall go with this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and Mejiro Palmer are looking over the special menu… but every dish displayed is a vibrant red!
choice_data_list: It all looks incredibly spicy. Are you sure?
It all looks incredibly spicy. Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's all part of the experience. You needn't be concerned. I'm quite confident I'll be able to finish whatever I'm served.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my mind's pretty much made up. How about you, Ardan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well… I've narrowed it down to two possibilities, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Given this is something of a special occasion, Trainer, I think I'd like you to make the decision for me. Would you mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Mejiro Ardan gestures toward the menu.
choice_data_list: "Punch of Power: Flamin' Hot Mapo Tofu & Beef."
"No Guts, No Glory: Tan Tan Noodle Inferno."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Very well… One "Punch of Power: Flamin' Hot Mapo Tofu & Beef" please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: PFFF! Haha! You can't just read the whole name off the menu like that, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Order up! Here's your Punch of Power special!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bowl of what looks to be freshly ladled lava is placed in front of Mejiro Ardan. Just looking at the dish has me sweating up a storm! Mejiro Ardan, however…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Wow! Such vivid coloration, and so intense an aroma. Well, without further ado.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan downs the bowl without batting an eye—though I do spot a bead of sweat on her brow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! Now that had some kick! But it was a good kick, amirite?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Indeed. The first bite caught me off guard, but there was real depth to the spice and an abundance of flavor to it. Delicious.
choice_data_list: So you're good with spicy food, huh?
So you're good with spicy food, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: While I'm not sure whether I'm "good" with spice… I am quite confident in my ability to withstand shocks to the body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's due to the number of opportunities I had to ingest bitter things during my childhood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Geez, Ardan, if this was a tolerance contest, you'd be unstoppable. None of us other Mejiros would stand a chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A tolerance contest! …I'd love the opportunity to enter such a competition!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If the occasion were to arise, perhaps you'd care to join me, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, so I could make sure you don't overdo it.
Yeah, so I could make sure you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha! I can totally see that, lol!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. With my track record, I'm afraid I can't deny the possibility. I'll have to ask for your guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We go on shooting the breeze and enjoying ourselves, and I come away sure that today will become another summer memory shared with Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Very well… One "No Guts, No Glory: Tan Tan Noodle Inferno" please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's due to the number of opportunities I had to ingest bitter things during my childhood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You know something, Ardan? You've got, like, nerves of steel! Trying out new stuff doesn't faze you one bit. It's like you're always game to just jump right in, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Does it seem that way? I can't say I'm making a conscious effort to think that way…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I suppose I may have a "now or never" mentality, though. I always feel like I would regret letting opportunities slip by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: In that case, we've totally gotta have the best beach day ever! Then you'll literally have, like, no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Quite right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yo, Ardan! Palmer! You guys want some ice cream? They let you put whatever fruits you want on top!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: For real? That sounds so good! Let's go, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Come along, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We eat to our hearts' content, and I come away sure that today will become another summer memory shared with Mejiro Ardan.
